name: 48532 · Flint, MI
findings: ZIP 48532 (Flint) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48532 (Flint) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48532 (Flint) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
